commits.message:
feat(core,plugin-wordcount): add plugin setup lifecycle in Phase 1

Introduce a backward-compatible plugin setup/onDispose lifecycle in core and migrate wordcount to auto-bind through setup while keeping the legacy attach helper intact. Update docs, demo wiring, and tests so existing static plugins continue to work unchanged.

feat(core): add plugin dependency sorting, buses, and diagnostics

Implement Phase 2 plugin extensibility with dependsOn-based topological ordering, runtime command and plugin-event bus APIs, and structured plugin diagnostics for dependency/setup/runtime failures. Update docs and tests while keeping existing plugins fully backward-compatible.

feat(core): add runtime plugin lifecycle management APIs

Implement Phase 3 ecosystem plugin management with use/unuse/reload APIs, active-plugin introspection, and runtime setup/teardown orchestration while preserving backwards compatibility for existing plugins. Update docs and tests to cover runtime activation, deactivation, and reload flows.

feat(core): add scoped setup facades for plugin context

Optimize the plugin architecture by extending setup context with scoped command, event, and diagnostics facades, including automatic cleanup of setup-registered resources on plugin unload. Update docs and tests to cover the new context capabilities while preserving backward compatibility.

fix(core): restore dependency diagnostics and align runtime-order test

Ensure single-plugin dependency validation still emits missing-dependency diagnostics, and update the runtime dependsOn test fixture to declare its actual dependency so the assertion matches the intended behavior.

test(wordcount): add runtime plugin activation and unload cleanup coverage

Add regression coverage for runtime plugin management by verifying wordcount can be activated via usePlugin and that status-bar DOM is removed after unusePlugin.
